+        "draft_distance": _label(
+            DISTANCE_LABELS,
+            row.get("confirmed_distance") or row.get("suggested_distance") or "mid",
+            "mid",
+        ),
+        "draft_difficulty": _label(
+            DIFFICULTY_LABELS,
+            difficulty,
+            "",
+        ),
+        "draft_visibility": _label(
+            VISIBILITY_LABELS,
+            visibility,
+            "visible",
+        ),
+        "draft_region": _label(
+            REGION_LABELS,
+            contact.get("contact_region") or "unknown",
+            "unknown",
+        ),
+        "dirty": False,
+    }
+
+
+def initial_state() -> dict[str, object]:
+    queue, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index = _load()
+    index = _first_pending(queue, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index)
+    return _new_state(queue, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index, index)
+
+
+def _suggested_bbox(row: dict[str, str]) -> list[float] | None:
+    values = [
+        row.get(field, "")
+        for field in (
+            "suggested_bbox_x1",
+            "suggested_bbox_y1",
+            "suggested_bbox_x2",
+            "suggested_bbox_y2",
+        )
+    ]
+    return [float(value) for value in values] if all(values) else None
+
+
+def _suggested_contact(row: dict[str, str]) -> tuple[float, float] | None:
+    if not row.get("suggested_contact_x") or not row.get("suggested_contact_y"):
+        return None
+    return float(row["suggested_contact_x"]), float(row["suggested_contact_y"])
+
+
+def _scale_box(box, image_size, display_size):
+    ow, oh = image_size
+    dw, dh = display_size
+    x1, y1, x2, y2 = box
+    return x1 * dw / ow, y1 * dh / oh, x2 * dw / ow, y2 * dh / oh
+
+
+def _scale_point(point, image_size, display_size):
+    ow, oh = image_size
+    dw, dh = display_size
+    return point[0] * dw / ow, point[1] * dh / oh
+
+
+def _draw_point(draw: ImageDraw.ImageDraw, point, color: str, radius: int, cross: bool) -> None:
+    x, y = point
+    draw.ellipse(
+        (x - radius, y - radius, x + radius, y + radius),
+        fill=color,
+        outline="white",
+        width=2,
+    )
+    if cross:
+        extent = radius + 8
+        draw.line((x - extent, y, x + extent, y), fill=color, width=5)
+        draw.line((x, y - extent, x, y + extent), fill=color, width=5)
+
+
+def _render(queue, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index, state):
+    row = queue[int(state["queue_index"])]
+    filename = row["filename"]
+    box_record = boxes[box_index[filename]]
+    contact_record = contact_rows[contact_index[filename]]
+    image = read_rgb(PROJECT_ROOT, box_record)
+    display_size = _display_size(image)
+    state["original_size"] = image.size
+    state["display_size"] = display_size
+    shown = image.resize(display_size, Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
+    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(shown)
+
+    suggestion = _suggested_bbox(row)
+    if suggestion:
+        draw.rectangle(
+            _scale_box(suggestion, image.size, display_size),
+            outline=SUGGESTED_BOX_COLOR,
+            width=5,
+        )
+    saved = record_bbox(box_record)
+    if saved:
+        draw.rectangle(
+            _scale_box(saved.as_list(), image.size, display_size),
+            outline=SAVED_BOX_COLOR,
+            width=6,
+        )
+    candidate = state.get("candidate_bbox")
+    if candidate:
+        draw.rectangle(
+            _scale_box(candidate, image.size, display_size),
+            outline=DRAFT_BOX_COLOR,
+            width=9,
+        )
+    if state.get("first_corner"):
+        x, y = _scale_point(state["first_corner"], image.size, display_size)
+        _draw_point(draw, (x, y), DRAFT_BOX_COLOR, 9, False)
+
+    suggested_point = _suggested_contact(row)
+    if suggested_point:
+        _draw_point(
+            draw,
+            _scale_point(suggested_point, image.size, display_size),
+            SUGGESTED_POINT_COLOR,
+            10,
+            False,
+        )
+    saved_point = contacts.contact_point(contact_record)
+    if saved_point:
+        _draw_point(
+            draw,
+            _scale_point(saved_point, image.size, display_size),
+            SAVED_POINT_COLOR,
+            13,
+            True,
+        )
+    candidate_point = state.get("candidate_contact")
+    if candidate_point:
+        _draw_point(
+            draw,
+            _scale_point(candidate_point, image.size, display_size),
+            DRAFT_POINT_COLOR,
+            15,
+            True,
+        )
+    return shown
+
+
+def _last_saved(box: dict[str, str], contact: dict[str, str]) -> str:
+    values = [value for value in (box.get("updated_at"), contact.get("updated_at")) if value]
+    return max(values) if values else "尚未保存"
+
+
+def _progress(queue, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index, state) -> str:
+    index = int(state["queue_index"])
+    row = queue[index]
+    filename = row["filename"]
+    box = boxes[box_index[filename]]
+    contact = contact_rows[contact_index[filename]]
+    finished = sum(
+        _finished(item, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index) for item in queue
+    )
+    box_status = "已确认" if box["review_state"] == "confirmed" else "未确认"
+    contact_status = "已确认" if contact["review_state"] == "confirmed" else "未确认"
+    dirty_status = "有，必须保存或放弃后才能切换图片" if state.get("dirty") else "无"
+    return (
+        f"## MANUAL ACTION REQUIRED：多样性测试集 {finished}/24\n"
+        f"当前：**{index + 1}/24 · {filename}**　点击模式：**{state['mode']}**\n\n"
+        f"正式状态：设备框 **{box_status}**，接触点 **{contact_status}**；"
+        f"最后保存：`{_last_saved(box, contact)}`\n\n"
+        f"**未保存修改：{dirty_status}**\n\n"
+        "橙色框/粉色点是模型建议；黄色框/紫色点是未保存草稿；"
+        "绿色框/青色点才是已经写入文件的人工标签。"
+    )
+
+
+def _instructions(state) -> str:
+    click_tip = (
+        "当前点击图片会记录设备框左上角和右下角。"
+        if state["mode"] == "bbox"
+        else "当前点击图片会记录或修改接触点。"
+    )
+    return (
+        "### 操作顺序\n"
+        f"1. {click_tip}\n"
+        "2. 核对视角、距离、困难类型、接触点可见性和脸部区域。\n"
+        "3. 点击“保存本张全部人工结果并进入下一张”。\n\n"
+        "采用模型建议只会生成黄色/紫色草稿，不会直接写入正式标签。"
+        "如果接触位置无法可靠判断，请把可见性选择为“无法可靠标注”。"
+    )
+
+
+def _default_message(state) -> str:
+    if state.get("dirty"):
+        return "**当前有未保存修改。请保存本张，或点击“放弃未保存修改”。**"
+    return "当前没有未保存修改。"
+
+
+def _outputs(queue, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index, state, message=""):
+    row = queue[int(state["queue_index"])]
+    box = boxes[box_index[row["filename"]]]
+    contact = contact_rows[contact_index[row["filename"]]]
+    saved_bbox = record_bbox(box)
+    bbox = state.get("candidate_bbox") or (
+        saved_bbox.as_list() if saved_bbox else [None, None, None, None]
+    )
+    point = state.get("candidate_contact") or contacts.contact_point(contact) or (None, None)
+    return (
+        _render(queue, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index, state),
+        state,
+        _progress(queue, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index, state),
+        _instructions(state),
+        message or _default_message(state),
+        state["draft_view"],
+        state["draft_distance"],
+        state["draft_difficulty"],
+        *bbox,
+        point[0],
+        point[1],
+        state["draft_visibility"],
+        state["draft_region"],
+    )
+
+
+def on_load():
+    state = initial_state()
+    return _outputs(*_load(), state, "请从第一张未完成图片开始。")
+
+
+def update_draft_field(state, field: str, value):
+    state = dict(state)
+    if value is not None and state.get(field) != value:
+        state[field] = value
+        state["dirty"] = True
+    return state, _default_message(state)
+
+
+def _navigation_blocked(state) -> bool:
+    return bool(state.get("dirty") or state.get("first_corner"))
+
+
+def move(state, step):
+    queue, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index = _load()
+    state = dict(state)
+    if _navigation_blocked(state):
+        return _outputs(
+            queue,
+            boxes,
+            contact_rows,
+            box_index,
+            contact_index,
+            state,
+            "当前图片有未保存修改，已阻止切换。请先保存或放弃修改。",
+        )
+    index = (int(state["queue_index"]) + step) % len(queue)
+    state = _new_state(queue, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index, index)
+    return _outputs(queue, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index, state)
+
+
+def jump_pending(state):
+    queue, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index = _load()
+    state = dict(state)
+    if _navigation_blocked(state):
+        return _outputs(
+            queue,
+            boxes,
+            contact_rows,
+            box_index,
+            contact_index,
+            state,
+            "当前图片有未保存修改，已阻止跳转。请先保存或放弃修改。",
+        )
+    index = _first_pending(queue, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index)
+    state = _new_state(queue, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index, index)
+    return _outputs(
+        queue,
+        boxes,
+        contact_rows,
+        box_index,
+        contact_index,
+        state,
+        "已跳到第一张未完成图片。",
+    )
+
+
+def discard_changes(state):
+    queue, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index = _load()
+    index = int(state["queue_index"])
+    state = _new_state(queue, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index, index)
+    return _outputs(
+        queue,
+        boxes,
+        contact_rows,
+        box_index,
+        contact_index,
+        state,
+        "已放弃当前图片的未保存修改，并恢复到上次正式保存状态。",
+    )
+
+
+def set_click_mode(state, mode: str):
+    queue, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index = _load()
+    state = dict(state)
+    state["mode"] = mode
+    state["first_corner"] = None
+    return _outputs(
+        queue,
+        boxes,
+        contact_rows,
+        box_index,
+        contact_index,
+        state,
+        "点击模式已切换为设备框。" if mode == "bbox" else "点击模式已切换为接触点。",
+    )
+
+
+def select_image(state, evt: gr.SelectData):
+    queue, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index = _load()
+    state = dict(state)
+    if not isinstance(evt.index, (tuple, list)) or len(evt.index) < 2:
+        return _outputs(queue, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index, state, "点击坐标无效。")
+    dw, dh = state["display_size"]
+    ow, oh = state["original_size"]
+    x = int(round(float(evt.index[0]) * ow / max(dw, 1)))
+    y = int(round(float(evt.index[1]) * oh / max(dh, 1)))
+    state["dirty"] = True
+    if state["mode"] == "contact":
+        state["candidate_contact"] = [x, y]
+        return _outputs(
+            queue,
+            boxes,
+            contact_rows,
+            box_index,
+            contact_index,
+            state,
+            f"紫色草稿接触点已记录为 ({x}, {y})，尚未保存。",
+        )
+    if state.get("first_corner") is None:
+        state["first_corner"] = [x, y]
+        state["candidate_bbox"] = None
+        return _outputs(
+            queue,
+            boxes,
+            contact_rows,
+            box_index,
+            contact_index,
+            state,
+            "黄色草稿框已记录第一个角点，请点击另一个对角点。",
+        )
+    try:
+        box = BBox(*state["first_corner"], x, y).normalized(ow, oh)
+    except ValueError as exc:
+        state["first_corner"] = None
+        return _outputs(
+            queue, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index, state, f"设备框无效：{exc}"
+        )
+    state["first_corner"] = None
+    state["candidate_bbox"] = box.as_list()
+    state["mode"] = "contact"
+    return _outputs(
+        queue,
+        boxes,
+        contact_rows,
+        box_index,
+        contact_index,
+        state,
+        "黄色草稿框已完成，尚未保存。现在可以点击接触点。",
+    )
+
+
+def use_suggested_bbox(state):
+    queue, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index = _load()
+    state = dict(state)
+    suggestion = _suggested_bbox(queue[int(state["queue_index"])])
+    if not suggestion:
+        return _outputs(
+            queue, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index, state, "当前图片没有模型建议框。"
+        )
+    state.update(
+        mode="contact",
+        first_corner=None,
+        candidate_bbox=suggestion,
+        dirty=True,
+    )
+    return _outputs(
+        queue,
+        boxes,
+        contact_rows,
+        box_index,
+        contact_index,
+        state,
+        "模型建议框已复制为黄色草稿，尚未保存。",
+    )
+
+
+def use_suggested_contact(state):
+    queue, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index = _load()
+    state = dict(state)
+    suggestion = _suggested_contact(queue[int(state["queue_index"])])
+    if not suggestion:
+        return _outputs(
+            queue, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index, state, "当前图片没有接触点建议。"
+        )
+    state.update(
+        mode="contact",
+        candidate_contact=list(suggestion),
+        dirty=True,
+    )
+    return _outputs(
+        queue,
+        boxes,
+        contact_rows,
+        box_index,
+        contact_index,
+        state,
+        "模型建议点已复制为紫色草稿，尚未保存。",
+    )
+
+
+def _restore_file(path: Path, content: bytes) -> None:
+    temp_path = path.with_suffix(path.suffix + ".rollback.tmp")
+    temp_path.write_bytes(content)
+    os.replace(temp_path, path)
+
+
+def _save_bundle(queue, boxes, contact_rows) -> None:
+    paths = (
+        bbox_annotation_path(PROJECT_ROOT),
+        contacts.annotation_path(PROJECT_ROOT),
+        MANIFEST_PATH,
+    )
+    snapshots = {path: path.read_bytes() for path in paths}
+    try:
+        save_bbox_records(PROJECT_ROOT, boxes)
+        contacts.save_records(PROJECT_ROOT, contact_rows)
+        write_manifest(MANIFEST_PATH, queue)
+    except Exception as exc:
+        rollback_errors = []
+        for path, content in snapshots.items():
+            try:
+                _restore_file(path, content)
+            except Exception as rollback_exc:
+                rollback_errors.append(f"{path.name}: {rollback_exc}")
+        detail = f"；回滚异常：{'; '.join(rollback_errors)}" if rollback_errors else ""
+        raise RuntimeError(f"标签保存失败，已恢复保存前内容：{exc}{detail}") from exc
+
+
+def _selected_or_state(state, values: dict[str, str | None]) -> dict[str, object]:
+    state = dict(state)
+    for field, value in values.items():
+        if value is not None:
+            state[field] = value
+    return state
+
+
+def _required_selection(state, field: str, reverse_mapping: dict[str, str], name: str) -> str:
+    value = state.get(field)
+    if value not in reverse_mapping:
+        raise ValueError(f"请选择{name}。")
+    return reverse_mapping[str(value)]
+
+
+def save_all(
+    state,
+    view_label,
+    distance_label,
+    difficulty_label,
+    visibility_label,
+    region_label,
+):
+    queue, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index = _load()
+    state = _selected_or_state(
+        state,
+        {
+            "draft_view": view_label,
+            "draft_distance": distance_label,
+            "draft_difficulty": difficulty_label,
+            "draft_visibility": visibility_label,
+            "draft_region": region_label,
+        },
+    )
+    row = queue[int(state["queue_index"])]
+    filename = row["filename"]
+    box_index_value = box_index[filename]
+    contact_index_value = contact_index[filename]
+    existing_box = record_bbox(boxes[box_index_value])
+    bbox_values = state.get("candidate_bbox") or (
+        existing_box.as_list() if existing_box else None
+    )
+    try:
+        if not bbox_values:
+            raise ValueError("请先画设备框或采用模型建议框。")
+        bbox = BBox(*bbox_values).normalized(
+            int(boxes[box_index_value]["width"]),
+            int(boxes[box_index_value]["height"]),
+        )
+        view = _required_selection(state, "draft_view", LABEL_TO_VIEW, "视角")
+        distance = _required_selection(
+            state, "draft_distance", LABEL_TO_DISTANCE, "拍摄距离"
+        )
+        difficulty = _required_selection(
+            state, "draft_difficulty", LABEL_TO_DIFFICULTY, "困难类型"
+        )
+        visibility = _required_selection(
+            state, "draft_visibility", LABEL_TO_VISIBILITY, "接触点可见性"
+        )
+        set_device(
+            boxes[box_index_value],
+            bbox,
+            source="manual_diversity_v1",
+            view=view,
+        )
+        if visibility == "not_annotatable":
+            contacts.set_not_annotatable(contact_rows[contact_index_value])
+        else:
+            point = (
+                state.get("candidate_contact")
+                or contacts.contact_point(contact_rows[contact_index_value])
+            )
+            if not point:
+                raise ValueError("请点击接触点或采用模型建议点。")
+            region = _required_selection(
+                state, "draft_region", LABEL_TO_REGION, "接触点所在脸部区域"
+            )
+            if region == "unknown":
+                raise ValueError(
+                    "有接触点坐标时请选择明确脸部区域；无法判断时请选择“无法可靠标注”。"
+                )
+            contacts.set_contact(
+                contact_rows[contact_index_value],
+                tuple(point),
+                visibility,
+                source="manual_confirmed",
+                region=region,
+            )
+        row["confirmed_view"] = view
+        row["confirmed_distance"] = distance
+        row["confirmed_difficulty"] = difficulty
+        row["review_state"] = "confirmed"
+        _save_bundle(queue, boxes, contact_rows)
+    except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError, RuntimeError) as exc:
+        state["dirty"] = True
+        return _outputs(
+            queue,
+            boxes,
+            contact_rows,
+            box_index,
+            contact_index,
+            state,
+            f"**未保存：{exc}**",
+        )
+
+    next_index = _first_pending(queue, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index)
+    next_state = _new_state(
+        queue, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index, next_index
+    )
+    return _outputs(
+        queue,
+        boxes,
+        contact_rows,
+        box_index,
+        contact_index,
+        next_state,
+        f"已一次性保存 {filename} 的全部人工结果，并进入下一张未完成图片。",
+    )
+
+

def _display_size(image: Image.Image) -> tuple[int, int]:

    contact_index = {row["filename"]: index for index, row in enumerate(contact_rows)}
    missing = [

        width=2,
    )
    if cross:
        extent = radius + 8
        draw.line((x - extent, y, x + extent, y), fill=color, width=5)
        draw.line((x, y - extent, x, y + extent), fill=color, width=5)


def _render(queue, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index, state):
    row = queue[int(state["queue_index"])]
    filename = row["filename"]
    box_record = boxes[box_index[filename]]
    contact_record = contact_rows[contact_index[filename]]
    image = read_rgb(PROJECT_ROOT, box_record)
    display_size = _display_size(image)
    state["original_size"] = image.size
    state["display_size"] = display_size
    shown = image.resize(display_size, Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(shown)

    suggestion = _suggested_bbox(row)
    if suggestion:
        draw.rectangle(
            _scale_box(suggestion, image.size, display_size),
            outline=SUGGESTED_BOX_COLOR,
            width=5,
        )
    saved_box = record_bbox(box_record)
    if saved_box:
        draw.rectangle(
            _scale_box(saved_box.as_list(), image.size, display_size),
            outline=SAVED_BOX_COLOR,
            width=6,
        )
    candidate_box = state.get("candidate_bbox")
    if candidate_box:
        draw.rectangle(
            _scale_box(candidate_box, image.size, display_size),
            outline=DRAFT_BOX_COLOR,
            width=9,
        )
    if state.get("first_corner"):
        _draw_point(
            draw,
            _scale_point(state["first_corner"], image.size, display_size),
            DRAFT_BOX_COLOR,
            9,
            False,
        )

    suggested_point = _suggested_contact(row)
    if suggested_point:
        _draw_point(
            draw,
            _scale_point(suggested_point, image.size, display_size),
            SUGGESTED_POINT_COLOR,
            10,
            False,
        )
    saved_point = contacts.contact_point(contact_record)
    if saved_point:
        _draw_point(
            draw,
            _scale_point(saved_point, image.size, display_size),
            SAVED_POINT_COLOR,
            13,
            True,
        )
    candidate_point = state.get("candidate_contact")
    if candidate_point:
        _draw_point(
            draw,
            _scale_point(candidate_point, image.size, display_size),
            DRAFT_POINT_COLOR,
            15,
            True,
        )
    return shown


def _last_saved(box, contact) -> str:
    values = [value for value in (box.get("updated_at"), contact.get("updated_at")) if value]
    return max(values) if values else "尚未保存"


def _progress(queue, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index, state) -> str:
    index = int(state["queue_index"])
    row = queue[index]
    filename = row["filename"]
    box = boxes[box_index[filename]]
    contact = contact_rows[contact_index[filename]]
    finished = sum(
        _finished(item, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index) for item in queue
    )
    box_status = "已确认" if box["review_state"] == "confirmed" else "未确认"
    contact_status = "已确认" if contact["review_state"] == "confirmed" else "未确认"
    dirty_status = "有，必须保存或放弃后才能切换图片" if state.get("dirty") else "无"
    return (
        f"## MANUAL ACTION REQUIRED：多样性测试集 {finished}/24\n"
        f"当前：**{index + 1}/24 · {filename}**　点击模式：**{state['mode']}**\n\n"
        f"正式状态：设备框 **{box_status}**，接触点 **{contact_status}**；"
        f"最后保存：`{_last_saved(box, contact)}`\n\n"
        f"**未保存修改：{dirty_status}**\n\n"
        "橙色框/粉色点是模型建议；黄色框/紫色点是未保存草稿；"
        "绿色框/青色点才是已经写入文件的人工标签。"
    )


def _instructions(state) -> str:
    click_tip = (
        "当前点击图片会记录设备框左上角和右下角。"
        if state["mode"] == "bbox"
        else "当前点击图片会记录或修改接触点。"
    )
    return (
        "### 操作顺序\n"
        f"1. {click_tip}\n"
        "2. 核对视角、距离、困难类型、接触点可见性和脸部区域。\n"
        "3. 点击“保存本张全部人工结果并进入下一张”。\n\n"
        "采用模型建议只会生成黄色/紫色草稿，不会直接写入正式标签。"
        "如果接触位置无法可靠判断，请把可见性选择为“无法可靠标注”。"
    )


def _default_message(state) -> str:
    if state.get("dirty"):
        return "**当前有未保存修改。请保存本张，或点击“放弃未保存修改”。**"
    return "当前没有未保存修改。"


def _outputs(queue, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index, state, message=""):
    row = queue[int(state["queue_index"])]
    box = boxes[box_index[row["filename"]]]
    contact = contact_rows[contact_index[row["filename"]]]
    saved_bbox = record_bbox(box)
    bbox = state.get("candidate_bbox") or (
        saved_bbox.as_list() if saved_bbox else [None, None, None, None]
    )
    point = state.get("candidate_contact") or contacts.contact_point(contact) or (None, None)
    return (
        _render(queue, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index, state),
        state,
        _progress(queue, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index, state),
        _instructions(state),
        message or _default_message(state),
        state["draft_view"],
        state["draft_distance"],
        state["draft_difficulty"],
        *bbox,
        point[0],
        point[1],
        state["draft_visibility"],
        state["draft_region"],
    )


def on_load():
    state = initial_state()
    return _outputs(*_load(), state, "请从第一张未完成图片开始。")


def update_draft_field(state, field: str, value):
    state = dict(state)
    if value is not None and state.get(field) != value:
        state[field] = value
        state["dirty"] = True
    return state, _default_message(state)


def _navigation_blocked(state) -> bool:
    return bool(state.get("dirty") or state.get("first_corner"))


def move(state, step):
    queue, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index = _load()
    state = dict(state)
    if _navigation_blocked(state):
        return _outputs(
            queue,
            boxes,
            contact_rows,
            box_index,
            contact_index,
            state,
            "当前图片有未保存修改，已阻止切换。请先保存或放弃修改。",
        )
    index = (int(state["queue_index"]) + step) % len(queue)
    state = _new_state(queue, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index, index)
    return _outputs(queue, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index, state)


def jump_pending(state):
    queue, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index = _load()
    state = dict(state)
    if _navigation_blocked(state):
        return _outputs(
            queue,
            boxes,
            contact_rows,
            box_index,
            contact_index,
            state,
            "当前图片有未保存修改，已阻止跳转。请先保存或放弃修改。",
        )
    index = _first_pending(queue, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index)
    state = _new_state(queue, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index, index)
    return _outputs(
        queue,
        boxes,
        contact_rows,
        box_index,
        contact_index,
        state,
        "已跳到第一张未完成图片。",
    )


def discard_changes(state):
    queue, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index = _load()
    index = int(state["queue_index"])
    state = _new_state(queue, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index, index)
    return _outputs(
        queue,
        boxes,
        contact_rows,
        box_index,
        contact_index,
        state,
        "已放弃当前图片的未保存修改，并恢复到上次正式保存状态。",
    )


def set_click_mode(state, mode: str):
    queue, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index = _load()
    state = dict(state)
    state["mode"] = mode
    state["first_corner"] = None
    message = "点击模式已切换为设备框。" if mode == "bbox" else "点击模式已切换为接触点。"
    return _outputs(queue, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index, state, message)


def select_image(state, evt: gr.SelectData):
    queue, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index = _load()
    state = dict(state)
    if not isinstance(evt.index, (tuple, list)) or len(evt.index) < 2:
        return _outputs(queue, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index, state, "点击坐标无效。")
    dw, dh = state["display_size"]
    ow, oh = state["original_size"]
    x = int(round(float(evt.index[0]) * ow / max(dw, 1)))
    y = int(round(float(evt.index[1]) * oh / max(dh, 1)))
    state["dirty"] = True
    if state["mode"] == "contact":
        state["candidate_contact"] = [x, y]
        return _outputs(
            queue,
            boxes,
            contact_rows,
            box_index,
            contact_index,
            state,
            f"紫色草稿接触点已记录为 ({x}, {y})，尚未保存。",
        )
    if state.get("first_corner") is None:
        state["first_corner"] = [x, y]
        state["candidate_bbox"] = None
        return _outputs(
            queue,
            boxes,
            contact_rows,
            box_index,
            contact_index,
            state,
            "黄色草稿框已记录第一个角点，请点击另一个对角点。",
        )
    try:
        box = BBox(*state["first_corner"], x, y).normalized(ow, oh)
    except ValueError as exc:
        state["first_corner"] = None
        return _outputs(queue, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index, state, f"设备框无效：{exc}")
    state["first_corner"] = None
    state["candidate_bbox"] = box.as_list()
    state["mode"] = "contact"
    return _outputs(
        queue,
        boxes,
        contact_rows,
        box_index,
        contact_index,
        state,
        "黄色草稿框已完成，尚未保存。现在可以点击接触点。",
    )


def use_suggested_bbox(state):
    queue, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index = _load()
    state = dict(state)
    suggestion = _suggested_bbox(queue[int(state["queue_index"])])
    if not suggestion:
        return _outputs(queue, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index, state, "当前图片没有模型建议框。")
    state.update(mode="contact", first_corner=None, candidate_bbox=suggestion, dirty=True)
    return _outputs(
        queue,
        boxes,
        contact_rows,
        box_index,
        contact_index,
        state,
        "模型建议框已复制为黄色草稿，尚未保存。",
    )


def use_suggested_contact(state):
    queue, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index = _load()
    state = dict(state)
    suggestion = _suggested_contact(queue[int(state["queue_index"])])
    if not suggestion:
        return _outputs(queue, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index, state, "当前图片没有接触点建议。")
    state.update(mode="contact", candidate_contact=list(suggestion), dirty=True)
    return _outputs(
        queue,
        boxes,
        contact_rows,
        box_index,
        contact_index,
        state,
        "模型建议点已复制为紫色草稿，尚未保存。",
    )


def _restore_file(path: Path, content: bytes) -> None:
    temp_path = path.with_suffix(path.suffix + ".rollback.tmp")
    temp_path.write_bytes(content)
    os.replace(temp_path, path)


def _save_bundle(queue, boxes, contact_rows) -> None:
    paths = (
        bbox_annotation_path(PROJECT_ROOT),
        contacts.annotation_path(PROJECT_ROOT),
        MANIFEST_PATH,
    )
    snapshots = {path: path.read_bytes() for path in paths}
    try:
        save_bbox_records(PROJECT_ROOT, boxes)
        contacts.save_records(PROJECT_ROOT, contact_rows)
        write_manifest(MANIFEST_PATH, queue)
    except Exception as exc:
        rollback_errors = []
        for path, content in snapshots.items():
            try:
                _restore_file(path, content)
            except Exception as rollback_exc:
                rollback_errors.append(f"{path.name}: {rollback_exc}")
        detail = f"；回滚异常：{'; '.join(rollback_errors)}" if rollback_errors else ""
        raise RuntimeError(f"标签保存失败，已恢复保存前内容：{exc}{detail}") from exc


def _selected_or_state(state, values):
    state = dict(state)
    for field, value in values.items():
        if value is not None:
            state[field] = value
    return state


def _required_selection(state, field: str, reverse_mapping, name: str) -> str:
    value = state.get(field)
    if value not in reverse_mapping:
        raise ValueError(f"请选择{name}。")
    return reverse_mapping[str(value)]


def save_all(state, view_label, distance_label, difficulty_label, visibility_label, region_label):
    queue, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index = _load()
    state = _selected_or_state(
        state,
        {
            "draft_view": view_label,
            "draft_distance": distance_label,
            "draft_difficulty": difficulty_label,
            "draft_visibility": visibility_label,
            "draft_region": region_label,
        },
    )
    row = queue[int(state["queue_index"])]
    filename = row["filename"]
    box_position = box_index[filename]
    contact_position = contact_index[filename]
    existing_box = record_bbox(boxes[box_position])
    bbox_values = state.get("candidate_bbox") or (existing_box.as_list() if existing_box else None)
    try:
        if not bbox_values:
            raise ValueError("请先画设备框或采用模型建议框。")
        bbox = BBox(*bbox_values).normalized(
            int(boxes[box_position]["width"]),
            int(boxes[box_position]["height"]),
        )
        view = _required_selection(state, "draft_view", LABEL_TO_VIEW, "视角")
        distance = _required_selection(state, "draft_distance", LABEL_TO_DISTANCE, "拍摄距离")
        difficulty = _required_selection(state, "draft_difficulty", LABEL_TO_DIFFICULTY, "困难类型")
        visibility = _required_selection(state, "draft_visibility", LABEL_TO_VISIBILITY, "接触点可见性")
        set_device(boxes[box_position], bbox, source="manual_diversity_v1", view=view)
        if visibility == "not_annotatable":
            contacts.set_not_annotatable(contact_rows[contact_position])
        else:
            point = state.get("candidate_contact") or contacts.contact_point(contact_rows[contact_position])
            if not point:
                raise ValueError("请点击接触点或采用模型建议点。")
            region = _required_selection(state, "draft_region", LABEL_TO_REGION, "接触点所在脸部区域")
            if region == "unknown":
                raise ValueError("有接触点坐标时请选择明确脸部区域；无法判断时请选择“无法可靠标注”。")
            contacts.set_contact(
                contact_rows[contact_position],
                tuple(point),
                visibility,
                source="manual_confirmed",
                region=region,
            )
        row["confirmed_view"] = view
        row["confirmed_distance"] = distance
        row["confirmed_difficulty"] = difficulty
        row["review_state"] = "confirmed"
        _save_bundle(queue, boxes, contact_rows)
    except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError, RuntimeError) as exc:
        state["dirty"] = True
        return _outputs(queue, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index, state, f"**未保存：{exc}**")

    next_index = _first_pending(queue, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index)
    next_state = _new_state(queue, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index, next_index)
    return _outputs(
        queue,
        boxes,
        contact_rows,
        box_index,
        contact_index,
        next_state,
        f"已一次性保存 {filename} 的全部人工结果，并进入下一张未完成图片。",
    )


def no_device(state, view_label, distance_label, difficulty_label):
    queue, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index = _load()
    state = _selected_or_state(
        state,
        {
            "draft_view": view_label,
            "draft_distance": distance_label,
            "draft_difficulty": difficulty_label,
        },
    )
    row = queue[int(state["queue_index"])]
    filename = row["filename"]
    try:
        view = _required_selection(state, "draft_view", LABEL_TO_VIEW, "视角")
        distance = _required_selection(state, "draft_distance", LABEL_TO_DISTANCE, "拍摄距离")
        difficulty = _required_selection(state, "draft_difficulty", LABEL_TO_DIFFICULTY, "困难类型")
        set_no_device(
            boxes[box_index[filename]],
            source="manual_diversity_v1_no_device",
            view=view,
        )
        contacts.set_not_annotatable(contact_rows[contact_index[filename]])
        row["confirmed_view"] = view
        row["confirmed_distance"] = distance
        row["confirmed_difficulty"] = difficulty
        row["review_state"] = "confirmed"
        _save_bundle(queue, boxes, contact_rows)
    except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError, RuntimeError) as exc:
        state["dirty"] = True
        return _outputs(queue, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index, state, f"**未保存：{exc}**")

    next_index = _first_pending(queue, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index)
    next_state = _new_state(queue, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index, next_index)
    return _outputs(
        queue,
        boxes,
        contact_rows,
        box_index,
        contact_index,
        next_state,
        f"已将 {filename} 保存为无设备，并进入下一张未完成图片。",
    )


def build_app() -> gr.Blocks:
    with gr.Blocks(title="24张多样性测试集人工确认") as demo:
        gr.Markdown(
            "# 24张多样性测试集人工确认\n"
            "这些图片永久保留为未见测试集，不会加入训练。"
            "每张图片的全部选择只在点击总保存按钮后写入正式标签。"
        )
        progress = gr.Markdown()
        instructions = gr.Markdown()
        message = gr.Markdown()
        image = gr.Image(
            label="橙/粉=模型建议；黄/紫=未保存草稿；绿/青=已保存人工标签",
            type="pil",
        )
        with gr.Row():
            previous = gr.Button("上一张")
            pending = gr.Button("跳到未完成")
            next_button = gr.Button("下一张")
            discard = gr.Button("放弃未保存修改")
        with gr.Row():
            view = gr.Radio(list(VIEW_LABELS.values()), label="人工确认视角")
            distance = gr.Radio(list(DISTANCE_LABELS.values()), label="人工确认拍摄距离")
            difficulty = gr.Radio(list(DIFFICULTY_LABELS.values()), label="人工确认困难类型")
        with gr.Row():
            suggested_box = gr.Button("采用橙色模型建议框")
            redraw_box = gr.Button("重新画设备框")
            contact_mode = gr.Button("改接触点")
            suggested_point = gr.Button("采用粉色模型建议点")
        with gr.Row():
            visibility = gr.Radio(list(VISIBILITY_LABELS.values()), label="接触点可见性")
            region = gr.Radio(list(REGION_LABELS.values()), label="接触点所在脸部区域")
        with gr.Row():
            save_button = gr.Button("保存本张全部人工结果并进入下一张", variant="primary")
            no_device_button = gr.Button("确认无设备并保存本张")
        with gr.Accordion("高级坐标（只读显示）", open=False):
            box_values = [gr.Number(label=name) for name in ("x1", "y1", "x2", "y2")]
            contact_x = gr.Number(label="contact_x")
            contact_y = gr.Number(label="contact_y")
        state = gr.State({})
        outputs = [
            image,
            state,
            progress,
            instructions,
            message,
            view,
            distance,
            difficulty,
            *box_values,
            contact_x,
            contact_y,
            visibility,
            region,
        ]
        demo.load(on_load, outputs=outputs)
        image.select(select_image, inputs=state, outputs=outputs)
        previous.click(lambda value: move(value, -1), inputs=state, outputs=outputs)
        next_button.click(lambda value: move(value, 1), inputs=state, outputs=outputs)
        pending.click(jump_pending, inputs=state, outputs=outputs)
        discard.click(discard_changes, inputs=state, outputs=outputs)
        suggested_box.click(use_suggested_bbox, inputs=state, outputs=outputs)
        suggested_point.click(use_suggested_contact, inputs=state, outputs=outputs)
        redraw_box.click(lambda value: set_click_mode(value, "bbox"), inputs=state, outputs=outputs)
        contact_mode.click(lambda value: set_click_mode(value, "contact"), inputs=state, outputs=outputs)
        view.input(
            lambda current, value: update_draft_field(current, "draft_view", value),
            inputs=[state, view],
            outputs=[state, message],
        )
        distance.input(
            lambda current, value: update_draft_field(current, "draft_distance", value),
            inputs=[state, distance],
            outputs=[state, message],
        )
        difficulty.input(
            lambda current, value: update_draft_field(current, "draft_difficulty", value),
            inputs=[state, difficulty],
            outputs=[state, message],
        )
        visibility.input(
            lambda current, value: update_draft_field(current, "draft_visibility", value),
            inputs=[state, visibility],
            outputs=[state, message],
        )
        region.input(
            lambda current, value: update_draft_field(current, "draft_region", value),
            inputs=[state, region],
            outputs=[state, message],
        )
        save_button.click(
            save_all,
            inputs=[state, view, distance, difficulty, visibility, region],
            outputs=outputs,
        )
        no_device_button.click(
            no_device,
            inputs=[state, view, distance, difficulty],
            outputs=outputs,
        )
    return demo


def main() -> None:
    queue, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index = _load()
    pending_count = sum(
        not _finished(row, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index)
        for row in queue
    )
    port = choose_port()
    print("MANUAL ACTION REQUIRED", flush=True)
    print(f"需要人工确认：{pending_count}/24 张多样性测试图片", flush=True)
    first = queue[_first_pending(queue, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index)]
    print(f"第一张：{first['filename']}", flush=True)
    print(f"http://{HOST}:{port}", flush=True)
    build_app().queue(default_concurrency_limit=1).launch(
        server_name=HOST,
        server_port=port,
        share=False,
        show_error=True,
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":

def _stash_current(state, queue):
    state = dict(state)
    cache = dict(state.get("draft_cache") or {})
    filename = queue[int(state["queue_index"])]["filename"]
    if state.get("dirty") or state.get("first_corner"):
        cache[filename] = {key: state.get(key) for key in DRAFT_STATE_KEYS}
    else:
        cache.pop(filename, None)
    state["draft_cache"] = cache
    return state


def move(state, step):
    queue, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index = _load()
    state = _stash_current(state, queue)
    had_unsaved = bool(state.get("dirty") or state.get("first_corner"))
    index = (int(state["queue_index"]) + step) % len(queue)
    state = _new_state(
        queue,
        boxes,
        contact_rows,
        box_index,
        contact_index,
        index,
        draft_cache=state["draft_cache"],
    )
    message = (
        "已在当前浏览器会话中临时保留上一张草稿；返回该图片可继续修改。"
        if had_unsaved
        else "已切换图片。"
    )
    return _outputs(queue, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index, state, message)


def jump_pending(state):
    queue, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index = _load()
    state = _stash_current(state, queue)
    current = int(state["queue_index"])
    index = current
    for offset in range(1, len(queue) + 1):
        candidate = (current + offset) % len(queue)
        if not _finished(queue[candidate], boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index):
            index = candidate

    state = _new_state(
        queue,
        boxes,
        contact_rows,
        box_index,
        contact_index,
        index,
        draft_cache=state["draft_cache"],

def test_manual_redraw_hides_suggestions_and_saved_overlays(monkeypatch):
    queue, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index = _fixture()
    app.set_device(boxes[0], app.BBox(60, 60, 90, 90), source="test", view="front")
    app.contacts.set_contact(
        contact_rows[0],
        (75, 75),
        "visible",
        source="manual_confirmed",
        region="forehead",
    )
    fixture = (queue, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index)
    state = app._new_state(*fixture, 0)
    state.update(candidate_bbox=[10, 10, 50, 50], candidate_contact=[30, 30])
    monkeypatch.setattr(app, "_load", lambda: fixture)
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        app,
        "read_rgb",
        lambda _root, _record: Image.new("RGB", (100, 100), "black"),
    )

    outputs = app.start_manual_redraw(state)
    redraw_state = outputs[1]
    rendered = outputs[0]

    assert redraw_state["mode"] == "bbox"
    assert redraw_state["candidate_bbox"] is None
    assert redraw_state["candidate_contact"] is None
    assert redraw_state["suppress_suggestions"] is True
    assert redraw_state["manual_redraw"] is True
    assert redraw_state["dirty"] is True
    assert rendered.getpixel((10, 10)) == (0, 0, 0)
    assert rendered.getpixel((20, 25)) == (0, 0, 0)
    assert rendered.getpixel((60, 60)) == (0, 0, 0)
    assert rendered.getpixel((75, 75)) == (0, 0, 0)


def test_draft_overlay_sizes_are_reduced(monkeypatch):
    queue, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index = _fixture()
    state = app._new_state(queue, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index, 0)
    state.update(
        candidate_bbox=[10, 10, 50, 50],
        candidate_contact=[30, 30],
        suppress_suggestions=True,
    )
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        app,
        "read_rgb",
        lambda _root, _record: Image.new("RGB", (100, 100), "black"),
    )

    rendered = app._render(
        queue, boxes, contact_rows, box_index, contact_index, state
    )

    assert app.DRAFT_BOX_WIDTH == 4
    assert app.DRAFT_POINT_RADIUS == 8
    assert rendered.getpixel((30, 15)) == (0, 0, 0)
    assert rendered.getpixel((39, 39)) == (0, 0, 0)

import json

def seed_everything(seed: int) -> None:
    random.seed(seed)
    np.random.seed(seed)
    torch.manual_seed(seed)
    if torch.cuda.is_available():
        torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)


class CocoDeviceDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, dataset_root: Path, split: str, training: bool = False) -> None:

        self.images = sorted(payload["images"], key=lambda row: int(row["id"]))
        self.annotations: dict[int, list[dict[str, object]]] = defaultdict(list)
        for annotation in payload["annotations"]:
            self.annotations[int(annotation["image_id"])].append(annotation)

    def __len__(self) -> int:
        return len(self.images)

    def __getitem__(self, index: int):
        info = self.images[index]
        path = self.root / "images" / self.split / str(info["file_name"])
        with Image.open(path) as source:
            image = ImageOps.exif_transpose(source).convert("RGB")
        boxes: list[list[float]] = []
        for annotation in self.annotations[int(info["id"])]:
            x, y, width, height = (float(value) for value in annotation["bbox"])
            boxes.append([x, y, x + width, y + height])
        target = {
            "boxes": torch.tensor(boxes, dtype=torch.float32).reshape(-1, 4),
            "labels": torch.ones((len(boxes),), dtype=torch.int64),
            "image_id": torch.tensor(int(info["id"]), dtype=torch.int64),
            "area": torch.tensor(
                [(box[2] - box[0]) * (box[3] - box[1]) for box in boxes],
                dtype=torch.float32,
            ),
            "iscrowd": torch.zeros((len(boxes),), dtype=torch.int64),
        }
        if self.training and random.random() < 0.5:
            image = F.hflip(image)
            width = image.width
            if len(target["boxes"]):
                original = target["boxes"].clone()
                target["boxes"][:, 0] = width - original[:, 2]
                target["boxes"][:, 2] = width - original[:, 0]
        if self.training:
            brightness = 1.0 + random.uniform(-0.12, 0.12)
            contrast = 1.0 + random.uniform(-0.12, 0.12)
            image = F.adjust_brightness(image, brightness)
            image = F.adjust_contrast(image, contrast)
        tensor = F.convert_image_dtype(F.pil_to_tensor(image), torch.float32)
        return tensor, target


def collate_detection(batch):
    return tuple(zip(*batch))


def build_detector(pretrained: bool = True) -> FasterRCNN:
    weights = FasterRCNN_ResNet50_FPN_V2_Weights.DEFAULT if pretrained else None
    model = fasterrcnn_resnet50_fpn_v2(weights=weights, weights_backbone=None)
    input_features = model.roi_heads.box_predictor.cls_score.in_features
    model.roi_heads.box_predictor = FastRCNNPredictor(input_features, 2)
    return model


def box_iou(left: np.ndarray, right: np.ndarray) -> float:
    x1, y1 = max(left[0], right[0]), max(left[1], right[1])
    x2, y2 = min(left[2], right[2]), min(left[3], right[3])
    intersection = max(0.0, x2 - x1) * max(0.0, y2 - y1)
    left_area = max(0.0, left[2] - left[0]) * max(0.0, left[3] - left[1])
    right_area = max(0.0, right[2] - right[0]) * max(0.0, right[3] - right[1])
    return float(intersection / max(left_area + right_area - intersection, 1e-9))


def average_precision(recalls: np.ndarray, precisions: np.ndarray) -> float:
    if len(recalls) == 0:
        return 0.0
    values = []
    for recall_level in np.linspace(0.0, 1.0, 101):
        eligible = precisions[recalls >= recall_level]
        values.append(float(eligible.max()) if len(eligible) else 0.0)
    return float(np.mean(values))


def _evaluate_threshold(predictions: list[dict[str, object]], threshold: float) -> tuple[float, int, int, int]:
    candidates: list[tuple[float, bool]] = []
    ground_truth_count = sum(1 for row in predictions if row["ground_truth"] is not None)
    for row in predictions:
        gt = row["ground_truth"]
        matched = False
        for score, box in sorted(zip(row["scores"], row["boxes"]), reverse=True):
            is_true = gt is not None and not matched and box_iou(np.asarray(box), np.asarray(gt)) >= threshold
            candidates.append((float(score), bool(is_true)))
            matched = matched or is_true
    candidates.sort(key=lambda item: item[0], reverse=True)
    if not candidates:
        return 0.0, 0, 0, ground_truth_count
    true_positive = np.cumsum([item[1] for item in candidates], dtype=np.float64)
    false_positive = np.cumsum([not item[1] for item in candidates], dtype=np.float64)
    recall = true_positive / max(ground_truth_count, 1)
    precision = true_positive / np.maximum(true_positive + false_positive, 1)
    return average_precision(recall, precision), int(true_positive[-1]), int(false_positive[-1]), ground_truth_count


@torch.inference_mode()
def evaluate_model(model: FasterRCNN, loader, device: torch.device, score_threshold: float = 0.5) -> dict[str, float]:
    model.eval()
    predictions: list[dict[str, object]] = []
    negative_images = 0
    negative_false_positives = 0
    for images, targets in loader:
        outputs = model([image.to(device) for image in images])
        for output, target in zip(outputs, targets):
            boxes = output["boxes"].detach().cpu().numpy()
            scores = output["scores"].detach().cpu().numpy()
            keep = scores >= score_threshold
            gt_boxes = target["boxes"].numpy()
            ground_truth = gt_boxes[0].tolist() if len(gt_boxes) else None
            if ground_truth is None:
                negative_images += 1
                negative_false_positives += int(bool(keep.any()))
            predictions.append(
                {
                    "boxes": boxes.tolist(),
                    "scores": scores.tolist(),
                    "ground_truth": ground_truth,
                }
            )
    ap_values = []
    ap50 = 0.0
    true_positive = false_positive = ground_truth_count = 0
    for threshold in np.arange(0.50, 0.96, 0.05):
        ap, tp, fp, gt_count = _evaluate_threshold(predictions, float(threshold))
        ap_values.append(ap)
        if abs(threshold - 0.50) < 1e-6:
            ap50, true_positive, false_positive, ground_truth_count = ap, tp, fp, gt_count
    precision = true_positive / max(true_positive + false_positive, 1)
    recall = true_positive / max(ground_truth_count, 1)
    return {
        "ap": float(np.mean(ap_values)),
        "ap50": ap50,
        "precision": precision,
        "recall": recall,
        "no_device_false_positive_rate": negative_false_positives / max(negative_images, 1),
        "image_count": float(len(predictions)),
    }

import math

    10, 338, 297, 332, 284, 251, 389, 356, 454, 323, 361, 288, 397, 365,
    379, 378, 400, 377, 152, 148, 176, 149, 150, 136, 172, 58, 132, 93,
    234, 127, 162, 21, 54, 103, 67, 109,
)

LOCAL_REGION_POLYGONS: dict[str, tuple[tuple[float, float], ...]] = {
    "forehead": ((-0.68, -0.26), (0.68, -0.26), (0.62, 0.36), (-0.62, 0.36)),
    "nose_area": ((-0.22, 0.28), (0.22, 0.28), (0.24, 0.70), (-0.24, 0.70)),

    "subject_right_cheek": ((-0.70, 0.32), (-0.14, 0.32), (-0.18, 0.79), (-0.68, 0.79)),
    "subject_left_cheek": ((0.14, 0.32), (0.70, 0.32), (0.68, 0.79), (0.18, 0.79)),
}
LOCAL_JAWLINE_POLYGONS = (
    ((-0.72, 0.67), (-0.33, 0.67), (-0.27, 1.08), (-0.52, 1.13)),
    ((0.33, 0.67), (0.72, 0.67), (0.52, 1.13), (0.27, 1.08)),
)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class FaceGeometry2D:
    top: tuple[float, float]
    horizontal_unit: tuple[float, float]
    vertical_unit: tuple[float, float]
    width: float
    height: float
    face_hull: tuple[tuple[float, float], ...]
    local_region_polygons: dict[str, tuple[tuple[float, float], ...]]
    local_jawline_polygons: tuple[tuple[tuple[float, float], ...], ...]


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class RegionSuggestion:
    region: str
    confidence: float
    local_point: tuple[float, float] | None
    reason: str


def _point_in_polygon(point: tuple[float, float], polygon: Sequence[tuple[float, float]]) -> bool:
    x, y = point
    inside = False
    if len(polygon) < 3:
        return False
    previous_x, previous_y = polygon[-1]
    for current_x, current_y in polygon:
        if (current_y > y) != (previous_y > y):
            crossing_x = (previous_x - current_x) * (y - current_y) / (previous_y - current_y) + current_x
            if x < crossing_x:
                inside = not inside
        previous_x, previous_y = current_x, current_y
    return inside


def build_face_geometry(
    landmarks: Sequence[tuple[float, float]],
) -> FaceGeometry2D | None:
    if len(landmarks) <= max(454, max(FACE_OVAL_INDICES)):
        return None
    top = landmarks[10]
    chin = landmarks[152]
    subject_right_edge = landmarks[234]
    subject_left_edge = landmarks[454]
    vertical = (chin[0] - top[0], chin[1] - top[1])
    height = math.hypot(*vertical)
    width = math.dist(subject_right_edge, subject_left_edge)
    if height < 10.0 or width < 10.0:
        return None
    vertical_unit = (vertical[0] / height, vertical[1] / height)
    horizontal_unit = (-vertical_unit[1], vertical_unit[0])
    edge_direction = (
        subject_left_edge[0] - subject_right_edge[0],
        subject_left_edge[1] - subject_right_edge[1],
    )
    if horizontal_unit[0] * edge_direction[0] + horizontal_unit[1] * edge_direction[1] < 0:
        horizontal_unit = (-horizontal_unit[0], -horizontal_unit[1])
    return FaceGeometry2D(
        top=top,
        horizontal_unit=horizontal_unit,
        vertical_unit=vertical_unit,
        width=width,
        height=height,
        face_hull=tuple(landmarks[index] for index in FACE_OVAL_INDICES),
        local_region_polygons=LOCAL_REGION_POLYGONS,
        local_jawline_polygons=LOCAL_JAWLINE_POLYGONS,
    )


def to_local(point: tuple[float, float], geometry: FaceGeometry2D) -> tuple[float, float]:
    offset = (point[0] - geometry.top[0], point[1] - geometry.top[1])
    return (
        (offset[0] * geometry.horizontal_unit[0] + offset[1] * geometry.horizontal_unit[1])
        / geometry.width,
        (offset[0] * geometry.vertical_unit[0] + offset[1] * geometry.vertical_unit[1])
        / geometry.height,
    )


def to_image(point: tuple[float, float], geometry: FaceGeometry2D) -> tuple[float, float]:
    x, y = point
    return (
        geometry.top[0]
        + x * geometry.width * geometry.horizontal_unit[0]
        + y * geometry.height * geometry.vertical_unit[0],
        geometry.top[1]
        + x * geometry.width * geometry.horizontal_unit[1]
        + y * geometry.height * geometry.vertical_unit[1],
    )


def image_region_polygons(
    geometry: FaceGeometry2D,
) -> dict[str, tuple[tuple[tuple[float, float], ...], ...]]:
    polygons = {
        region: (tuple(to_image(point, geometry) for point in polygon),)
        for region, polygon in geometry.local_region_polygons.items()
    }
    polygons["jawline"] = tuple(
        tuple(to_image(point, geometry) for point in polygon)
        for polygon in geometry.local_jawline_polygons
    )
    return polygons


def classify_local_point(local_point: tuple[float, float]) -> RegionSuggestion:
    x, y = local_point
    if abs(x) > 0.90 or y < -0.32 or y > 1.20:
        return RegionSuggestion("outside_face", 0.95, local_point, "clearly_outside_face_domain")
    if _point_in_polygon(local_point, LOCAL_REGION_POLYGONS["forehead"]):
        return RegionSuggestion("forehead", 0.88, local_point, "inside_forehead_polygon")
    if _point_in_polygon(local_point, LOCAL_REGION_POLYGONS["nose_area"]):
        return RegionSuggestion("nose_area", 0.85, local_point, "inside_nose_polygon")
    if _point_in_polygon(local_point, LOCAL_REGION_POLYGONS["mouth_chin"]):
        return RegionSuggestion("mouth_chin", 0.85, local_point, "inside_mouth_chin_polygon")
    if any(_point_in_polygon(local_point, polygon) for polygon in LOCAL_JAWLINE_POLYGONS):
        return RegionSuggestion("jawline", 0.82, local_point, "inside_jawline_polygon")
    if _point_in_polygon(local_point, LOCAL_REGION_POLYGONS["subject_right_cheek"]):
        return RegionSuggestion(
            "subject_right_cheek", 0.82, local_point, "inside_subject_right_cheek_polygon"
        )
    if _point_in_polygon(local_point, LOCAL_REGION_POLYGONS["subject_left_cheek"]):
        return RegionSuggestion(
            "subject_left_cheek", 0.82, local_point, "inside_subject_left_cheek_polygon"
        )
    return RegionSuggestion("unknown", 0.0, local_point, "between_or_outside_defined_polygons")


def classify_face_region(
    point: tuple[float, float] | None,
    geometry: FaceGeometry2D | None,
) -> RegionSuggestion:
    if point is None:
        return RegionSuggestion("unknown", 0.0, None, "contact_point_is_null")
    if geometry is None:
        return RegionSuggestion("unknown", 0.0, None, "face_landmarks_unavailable")
    return classify_local_point(to_local(point, geometry))

def sha256(path: Path) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as handle:
        for block in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            digest.update(block)
    return digest.hexdigest()

                    (float(landmark.x) * width, float(landmark.y) * height)
                    for landmark in result.face_landmarks[0]
                ]
                geometry = build_face_geometry(landmarks)
            point_value = row.get("contact_point")
            point = tuple(float(value) for value in point_value) if point_value is not None else None
            suggestion = classify_face_region(point, geometry)
            filename = str(row["filename"])
            preview_path = output_root / "preview" / str(row["logical_split"]) / filename
            render_preview(
                image_path, preview_path, geometry, point, suggestion.region, suggestion.confidence
            )
            old = existing.get(filename, {})
            confirmed = old.get("confirmed_region", "") if old.get("review_state") == "confirmed" else ""
            review_state = "confirmed" if confirmed in REGIONS else "pending"
            review_rows.append(
                {
                    "filename": filename,
                    "logical_split": str(row["logical_split"]),
                    "image_path": str(image_path),
                    "raw_sha256": str(row["raw_sha256"]),
                    "contact_x": "" if point is None else f"{point[0]:.3f}",
                    "contact_y": "" if point is None else f"{point[1]:.3f}",
                    "face_detected": "true" if geometry is not None else "false",
                    "suggested_region": suggestion.region,
                    "suggestion_confidence": f"{suggestion.confidence:.6f}",
                    "suggestion_reason": suggestion.reason,
                    "confirmed_region": confirmed,
                    "review_state": review_state,
                    "reviewed_at": old.get("reviewed_at", "") if review_state == "confirmed" else "",
                    "preview_path": str(preview_path),
                }
            )
            landmark_payload[filename] = {
                "face_detected": geometry is not None,
                "landmarks": landmarks,
                "suggested_region": suggestion.region,
                "local_contact_point": suggestion.local_point,
            }
    output_root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    temporary = review_path.with_suffix(".csv.tmp")
    with temporary.open("w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as handle:
        writer = csv.DictWriter(handle, fieldnames=REVIEW_FIELDS)
        writer.writeheader()
        writer.writerows(review_rows)
    temporary.replace(review_path)
    (output_root / "landmarks.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(landmark_payload, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n", encoding="utf-8"
    )
    summary = {
        "schema_version": 1,
        "task": "manual_face_region_review",
        "sample_count": len(review_rows),
        "face_detected_count": sum(row["face_detected"] == "true" for row in review_rows),
        "suggestion_counts": dict(Counter(row["suggested_region"] for row in review_rows)),
        "confirmed_count": sum(row["review_state"] == "confirmed" for row in review_rows),
        "required_correct_for_gate": 13,
        "automatic_suggestions_are_formal_labels": False,
    }
    (output_root / "summary.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8"
    )
    (output_root / "model_info.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(
            {
                "name": "MediaPipe Face Landmarker",
                "mediapipe_version": mp.__version__,
                "model_url": MODEL_URL,
                "model_path": str(model_path),
                "model_size": model_path.stat().st_size,
                "model_sha256": sha256(model_path),
                "license": "Apache-2.0 (code); model subject to official model terms review",
            },
            ensure_ascii=False,
            indent=2,
        )
        + "\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    print(
        f"FACE_REGION_PREP=PASS rows={len(review_rows)} faces={summary['face_detected_count']} "
        f"confirmed={summary['confirmed_count']} path={review_path}"
    )
    return 0

<proposed_plan>
# 24 张多样性测试与完整流水线计划

## Summary
- 停止 Gradio，冻结当前 24 张 bbox、接触点、可见性和脸部区域标签。
- 首先复用现有 P2 设备模型、P3 接触点模型和 MediaPipe 区域规则完成一次端到端评估，不新增训练。
- 流程固定为：`原图 → 设备检测 → ROI → 接触点预测 → 人脸关键点 → 脸部区域`。
- 当前测试仍是单人物、当前拍摄条件，不代表新用户泛化。

## Implementation
- 保存标签 SHA256 快照，校验 24/24 confirmed、冻结清单不变、290 张原图 SHA256 不变。
- 建立 Git 提交与标签 `diversity-labels-v1`，生成 Git bundle 备份；不提交原图、缓存和大型临时输出。
- 新增统一 Python 推理入口，直接加载：
  - P2 YOLOX-Tiny ONNX；
  - P3 MobileNetV3-Small 接触点 ONNX；
  - MediaPipe Face Landmarker；
  - 二维脸部区域多边形规则。
- 输出到 `output-test-diversity-v1/`：
  - 24 张综合预览；
  - `predictions.jsonl`；
  - `metrics.json`；
  - `errors.csv`；
  - 按视角、距离和困难类型分类的联系表。
- 每张预览显示设备 GT/预测框、接触点 GT/预测点、人工区域/预测区域及置信度。
- 统一 `FrameResult` 包含 bbox、接触点、可见性、脸部区域、`needs_review`、模型版本和各阶段耗时。

## Acceptance
- 设备检测召回率 `>=90%`，任何视角或距离组不得全部漏检。
- 检测框 ROI 下接触点中位误差 `<=10%`、P90 `<=20%`、PCK@20 `>=85%`。
- 脸部区域在可标注图片上的准确率 `>=90%`；当前 24 张预计至少正确 21/23。
- `not_annotatable` 必须输出空接触点和 `unknown`，不得计作普通区域错误。
- 首次失败只生成问题清单，不把这 24 张加入训练；从其他未冻结图片选择相似训练样本后再改进。
- 通过后导出统一模型清单，完成 Python/C++ ONNX 对拍，并创建标签 `p3-diversity-integrated`。

## Test Plan
- 运行完整 pytest、ONNX checker、标签一致性和 `uv lock --check`。
- 验证 24 张没有训练泄漏、重复组泄漏或相邻帧泄漏。
- 验证所有预测坐标位于图像范围内，预览均可读取。
- 验证 Python/C++ bbox 与接触点反映射误差不超过 1 像素。
- 最终再次确认 290 张原图 SHA256 完全一致。

## Assumptions
- 本轮只评估和串联现有模型，不重新训练 P2/P3。
- 脸部区域属于规则映射，不再要求用户重复标注。
- 多样性测试通过后才继续 C++ 产品流水线和 HTTP 服务集成。
</proposed_plan>

    landmarks = [

    nose_local = to_local(landmarks[1], geometry)

def _predict_detector(exp, model, image: Image.Image, device: torch.device):
    from yolox.data.data_augment import ValTransform
    from yolox.utils import postprocess

    bgr = cv2.cvtColor(np.asarray(image.convert("RGB")), cv2.COLOR_RGB2BGR)
    ratio = min(exp.test_size[0] / bgr.shape[0], exp.test_size[1] / bgr.shape[1])
    tensor, _ = ValTransform(legacy=False)(bgr, None, exp.test_size)
    inputs = torch.from_numpy(tensor).unsqueeze(0).float().to(device)
    with torch.inference_mode():
        output = postprocess(
            model(inputs), 1, 0.01, exp.nmsthre, class_agnostic=True
        )[0]
    if output is None:
        return None, 0.0
    values = output.detach().cpu().numpy()
    scores = values[:, 4] * values[:, 5]
    row = values[int(np.argmax(scores))]
    box = tuple(float(value / ratio) for value in row[:4])
    x1 = max(0.0, min(box[0], float(image.width)))
    y1 = max(0.0, min(box[1], float(image.height)))
    x2 = max(0.0, min(box[2], float(image.width)))
    y2 = max(0.0, min(box[3], float(image.height)))

    return (x1, y1, x2, y2), float(np.max(scores))

def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Run a saved pilot device detector")
    parser.add_argument("--stage", choices=("p1", "p2"), default="p1")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--splits",
        nargs="+",
        choices=SUPPORTED_SPLITS,
        default=["val", "test"],
        help="dataset splits to run; default: val test",
    )
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--checkpoint", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--confidence", type=float, default=CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD)
    parser.add_argument("--device", choices=("auto", "cuda", "cpu"), default="auto")
    return parser


def default_paths(stage: str) -> tuple[Path, Path]:
    checkpoint = PROJECT_ROOT / "models" / "pilots" / stage / "yolox_tiny" / "best.pt"
    output = PROJECT_ROOT / ("output-test-p2" if stage == "p2" else "output-test")
    return checkpoint, output


def sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as handle:
        for block in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            digest.update(block)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def resolve_project_path(path: Path) -> Path:
    return path if path.is_absolute() else PROJECT_ROOT / path


def resolve_device(requested: str) -> torch.device:
    if requested == "auto":
        return torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
    if requested == "cuda" and not torch.cuda.is_available():
        raise RuntimeError("CUDA was requested but torch.cuda.is_available() is false")
    return torch.device(requested)


def _clean_generated_images(directory: Path) -> None:
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for path in directory.iterdir():
        if path.is_file() and path.suffix.lower() in {".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png"}:
            path.unlink()


def clean_split_outputs(split_root: Path) -> None:
    _clean_generated_images(split_root / "images")
    _clean_generated_images(split_root / "debug")
    for name in (
        "predictions.jsonl",
        "selected_predictions.jsonl",
        "raw_predictions.jsonl",
        "errors.csv",
        "metrics.json",
    ):
        path = split_root / name
        if path.is_file():
            path.unlink()


def _write_json(path: Path, value: object) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


def _read_jsonl(path: Path) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
    if not path.is_file():
        return []
    return [json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines() if line.strip()]


def write_ignored_previews(dataset: Path, output_root: Path, ignored: set[str]) -> None:
    ignored_root = output_root / "ignored"
    images_root = ignored_root / "images"
    _clean_generated_images(images_root)
    manifest = json.loads((dataset / "pilot_manifest.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    rows = [row for row in manifest["rows"] if row["filename"] in ignored]
    for row in rows:
        source = dataset / row["derived_file"]
        image = cv2.imread(str(source), cv2.IMREAD_COLOR)
        if image is None:
            raise RuntimeError(f"cannot read ignored image: {source}")
        draw_text_label(
            image,
            "IGNORED: positive-only baseline",
            (16, 42),
            (0, 165, 255),
            scale=0.85,
        )
        target = images_root / row["filename"]
        if not cv2.imwrite(str(target), image):
            raise RuntimeError(f"cannot write ignored preview: {target}")
    _write_json(
        ignored_root / "ignored.json",
        {
            "reason": "temporarily_excluded_from_positive_only_evaluation",
            "negative_sample_evaluation": "not_tested",
            "filenames": sorted(ignored),
        },
    )


def build_summary(output_root: Path, generated_splits: list[str], stage: str) -> dict[str, object]:
    split_metrics: dict[str, dict[str, object]] = {}
    for split in SUPPORTED_SPLITS:
        path = output_root / split / "metrics.json"
        if path.is_file():
            split_metrics[split] = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

    holdout: dict[str, object] | None = None
    if "val" in split_metrics and "test" in split_metrics:
        predictions = (
            _read_jsonl(output_root / "val" / "selected_predictions.jsonl")
            + _read_jsonl(output_root / "test" / "selected_predictions.jsonl")
        )
        positive_images = int(split_metrics["val"]["positive_images"]) + int(
            split_metrics["test"]["positive_images"]
        )
        matched = int(split_metrics["val"]["matched_images_at_iou50"]) + int(
            split_metrics["test"]["matched_images_at_iou50"]
        )
        ap50 = average_precision_at_50(predictions, positive_images)
        recall = matched / max(positive_images, 1)
        required_ap50 = 0.85 if stage == "p2" else 0.75
        required_recall = 0.90 if stage == "p2" else 0.80
        holdout = {
            "scope": "positive_samples_only" if stage == "p2" else "configured_holdout",
            "positive_images": positive_images,
            "ap50": ap50,
            "recall_at_iou50": recall,
            "test_recall": split_metrics["test"]["recall_at_threshold_iou50"],
            "required_ap50": required_ap50,
            "required_recall": required_recall,
            "result": "pass" if ap50 >= required_ap50 and recall >= required_recall else "blocked",
        }

    return {
        "schema_version": 1,
        "stage": stage,
        "task": "device_detection",
        "evaluation_scope": "positive_samples_only" if stage == "p2" else "configured_holdout",
        "negative_sample_evaluation": "not_tested" if stage == "p2" else "limited",
        "production_ready": False,
        "ignored_filenames": sorted(P2_IGNORED_FILENAMES) if stage == "p2" else [],
        "generated_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "generated_splits": generated_splits,
        "available_splits": list(split_metrics),
        "splits": split_metrics,
        "holdout": holdout,
        "contact_model_status": "not_trained",
        "contact_predictions_generated": False,
    }


def run(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    confidence = float(args.confidence)
    if not 0.0 < confidence <= 1.0:
        raise ValueError("--confidence must be in (0, 1]")
    splits = list(dict.fromkeys(args.splits))
    default_checkpoint, default_output = default_paths(args.stage)
    checkpoint = resolve_project_path(args.checkpoint or default_checkpoint).resolve()
    output_root = resolve_project_path(args.output or default_output).resolve()
    dataset = PROJECT_ROOT / "datasets" / "pilots" / args.stage
    if not checkpoint.is_file():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"saved checkpoint does not exist: {checkpoint}")
    if not (dataset / "pilot_manifest.json").is_file():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"{args.stage.upper()} dataset does not exist: {dataset}")

    device = resolve_device(args.device)
    output_root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    os.environ.update(
        {
            "MEDVISION_PILOT_STAGE": args.stage,
            "MEDVISION_PILOT_DATA_DIR": str(dataset),
            "MEDVISION_PILOT_OUTPUT_DIR": str(checkpoint.parent.parent),
        }
    )
    exp, model = load_yolox_model(PROJECT_ROOT, checkpoint, device)

    for split in splits:
        split_root = output_root / split
        clean_split_outputs(split_root)
        ignored = set(P2_IGNORED_FILENAMES) if args.stage == "p2" and split == "val" else set()
        result = evaluate_pilot_split(
            PROJECT_ROOT,
            args.stage,
            split,
            exp,
            model,
            device,
            preview_dir=split_root / "images",
            debug_preview_dir=split_root / "debug",
            predictions_path=split_root / "selected_predictions.jsonl",
            raw_predictions_path=split_root / "raw_predictions.jsonl",
            errors_path=split_root / "errors.csv",
            confidence_threshold=confidence,

def draw_marker(
    draw: ImageDraw.ImageDraw,
    point: tuple[float, float],
    color: str,
    label: str,
    *,
    radius: int,
    line_width: int,
    center_radius: int,
) -> None:
    x, y = point
    draw.ellipse(
        (x - radius, y - radius, x + radius, y + radius),
        outline=color,
        width=line_width,
    )
    draw.line((x - radius, y, x + radius, y), fill=color, width=line_width)
    draw.line((x, y - radius, x, y + radius), fill=color, width=line_width)
    draw.ellipse(
        (
            x - center_radius,
            y - center_radius,
            x + center_radius,
            y + center_radius,
        ),
        fill=color,
    )
    draw.rectangle(
        (x + radius + 5, y - radius, x + radius + 120, y - radius + 34),
        fill=(0, 0, 0),
    )
    draw.text((x + radius + 12, y - radius + 7), label, fill=color)


def render_preview(
    image_path: str,
    destination: Path,
    roi: tuple[float, float, float, float],
    gt_point: tuple[float, float] | None,
    predicted_point: tuple[float, float],

) -> None:

def evaluate_split(
    model: ContactPointNet,
    manifest_path: Path,
    split: str,
    roi_mode: str,
    report_root: Path,
    device: torch.device,
) -> tuple[dict[str, object], list[float]]:
    detected_boxes = load_detected_boxes(PROJECT_ROOT, split) if roi_mode == "detected_roi" else None
    dataset = ContactPointDataset(manifest_path, split, detected_boxes=detected_boxes)
    expected_count = len(dataset.rows)
    if detected_boxes is not None:
        dataset.rows = [
            row for row in dataset.rows if str(row["filename"]) in detected_boxes
        ]
    loader = DataLoader(dataset, batch_size=16, shuffle=False, num_workers=2, pin_memory=True)
    confusion = Counter()
    errors_px: list[float] = []
    errors_normalized: list[float] = []
    prediction_rows: list[dict[str, object]] = []
    correct_visibility = 0

    model.eval()
    with torch.inference_mode():
        for batch in loader:
            images = batch["image"].to(device, non_blocking=True)
            heatmap_logits, visibility_logits = model(images)
            visibility_indices = torch.argmax(visibility_logits, dim=1).cpu()
            for index, filename in enumerate(batch["filename"]):
                gt_visibility = VISIBILITY_CLASSES[int(batch["visibility"][index])]
                predicted_visibility = VISIBILITY_CLASSES[int(visibility_indices[index])]
                confusion[(gt_visibility, predicted_visibility)] += 1
                correct_visibility += int(gt_visibility == predicted_visibility)
                roi = tuple(float(value) for value in batch["roi"][index].tolist())
                predicted_point, confidence = peak_neighborhood_to_point(
                    heatmap_logits[index],
                    roi,
                )
                has_point = bool(batch["has_point"][index])
                gt_point = (
                    tuple(float(value) for value in batch["point_xy"][index].tolist())
                    if has_point
                    else None
                )
                error_px = None
                error_normalized = None
                if gt_point is not None:
                    error_px = math.dist(gt_point, predicted_point)
                    roi_diagonal = math.hypot(roi[2] - roi[0], roi[3] - roi[1])
                    error_normalized = error_px / max(roi_diagonal, 1.0)
                    errors_px.append(error_px)
                    errors_normalized.append(error_normalized)
                row = {
                    "filename": filename,
                    "split": split,
                    "roi_mode": roi_mode,
                    "roi": list(roi),
                    "gt_point": list(gt_point) if gt_point is not None else None,
                    "predicted_point": list(predicted_point),
                    "gt_visibility": gt_visibility,
                    "predicted_visibility": predicted_visibility,
                    "heatmap_confidence": confidence,
                    "point_error_px": error_px,
                    "point_error_roi_diagonal_ratio": error_normalized,
                    "needs_review": confidence < 0.05,
                }
                prediction_rows.append(row)
                render_preview(
                    str(batch["derived_file"][index]),
                    report_root / "preview" / roi_mode / split / filename,
                    roi,
                    gt_point,
                    predicted_point,
                    gt_visibility,
                    predicted_visibility,
                    confidence,
                )

    predictions_path = report_root / f"predictions_{roi_mode}_{split}.jsonl"
    predictions_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    predictions_path.write_text(
        "".join(json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n" for row in prediction_rows),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    confusion_json = {
        gt: {
            predicted: confusion[(gt, predicted)]
            for predicted in VISIBILITY_CLASSES
        }
        for gt in VISIBILITY_CLASSES
    }
    metrics = {
        "split": split,
        "roi_mode": roi_mode,
        "expected_images": expected_count,
        "evaluated_images": len(dataset),
        "detector_roi_coverage": len(dataset) / max(expected_count, 1),
        "visibility_accuracy": correct_visibility / max(len(dataset), 1),
        "visibility_confusion": confusion_json,
        "point_error_px_median": (
            sorted(errors_px)[len(errors_px) // 2] if errors_px else None
        ),
        **summarize_errors(errors_normalized),
    }
    return metrics, errors_normalized


def combine_metrics(
    split_metrics: list[dict[str, object]],
    errors: list[float],
) -> dict[str, object]:
    expected = sum(int(value["expected_images"]) for value in split_metrics)
    evaluated = sum(int(value["evaluated_images"]) for value in split_metrics)
    return {
        "expected_images": expected,
        "evaluated_images": evaluated,
        "detector_roi_coverage": evaluated / max(expected, 1),
        **summarize_errors(errors),
    }

def sha256(path: Path) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as handle:
        for block in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            digest.update(block)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def read_existing(path: Path) -> dict[str, dict[str, str]]:
    if not path.is_file():
        return {}
    with path.open("r", encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as handle:
        return {row["filename"]: row for row in csv.DictReader(handle)}


def draw_cross(draw: ImageDraw.ImageDraw, point: tuple[float, float], radius: int) -> None:
    x, y = point
    line = max(7, min(12, radius // 3))
    draw.ellipse((x - radius, y - radius, x + radius, y + radius), outline="#00e5ff", width=line)
    draw.line((x - radius, y, x + radius, y), fill="#00e5ff", width=line)
    draw.line((x, y - radius, x, y + radius), fill="#00e5ff", width=line)
    center = max(7, radius // 4)
    draw.ellipse((x - center, y - center, x + center, y + center), fill="#00e5ff")


def render_preview(
    image_path: Path,
    destination: Path,
    geometry,
    contact_point: tuple[float, float] | None,
    suggested_region: str,
    confidence: float,
) -> None:
    image = Image.open(image_path).convert("RGB")
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(image, "RGBA")
    if geometry is not None:
        for region, polygons in image_region_polygons(geometry).items():
            color = COLORS[region]
            for polygon in polygons:
                fill = color + ("42" if region == suggested_region else "12")
                width = 16 if region == suggested_region else 7
                draw.polygon(polygon, fill=fill, outline=color)
                draw.line((*polygon, polygon[0]), fill=color, width=width, joint="curve")
        draw.line((*geometry.face_hull, geometry.face_hull[0]), fill="#ffffff", width=5, joint="curve")
    if contact_point is not None:
        radius = max(24, min(48, round(min(image.size) * 0.015)))
        draw_cross(draw, contact_point, radius)
    banner = f"CYAN=MANUAL CONTACT | SUGGESTED={suggested_region} | CONF={confidence:.2f} | MUST REVIEW"
    draw.rectangle((8, 8, min(image.width - 8, 1800), 96), fill=(0, 0, 0, 220))
    draw.text((24, 28), banner, fill=(255, 255, 255, 255))

    image.save(destination, quality=92)
